### Why Cognac Can Hit Hard

- **Higher congener levels:** Like other brandies and dark liquors, cognac contains more congeners (such as methanol, fusel oils, and esters) than clear, heavily filtered spirits like vodka. These compounds can increase inflammation and compete with alcohol metabolism, making symptoms like headaches and nausea feel worse.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsAEBxCJF1zIrfcoC4Qo9Z6_KZWa78m9xKk4YvACFxQ6mj_tj8CDIiFAu66T_VOfji7zvFsxdfUzpn0ddMhsoNl7wcRIR4WlO8Jr0sizZCiTQYuOqP_MlitLQ_mAJt_EQ54hV9mV9ckjtweYv4ifgF4NwpR8xbQs8xX_zG9SEcC9gsATwf3Pi5xryZfmxMjOV1p0aJByi-VF4qN3MdC3V-UZuDP4EqgGfqrHzA1ajtkvkkw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1_prTz6waN-SJoRflSh2q2LM2l8XGSqT-8Yny6If8a1XRhP-0RibUABpTp_jaKIkPaX7ja3G3CIITSzvLs51Rhoal6t4sLVrBJ_FdaePB6Yl7sAdc-HUvvDnklfpExtZtAYNXNHA4nw2GY7ZDoSoWViGDQq21qBWNvsve5aspUJCzAB4gRw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESzQEBxCJF1zmaWoDKFd0A-uurINZJiXPiQavsltpdSmOGKH9hI5xlsb5t780voWMPMbJVOmKMcjVllYXGjJuNcqDKguEVhs_gFqGfnlsge4d2H-ToEsWvSmOnt9JBIlkG7OcZigJDiTENRVvst4VysfqH-XXT9nfIRIfqHlsTSe0prp8TsFMFA69zLklqXl1LCWLV9_EbdVUAQcQ6MjcqdW4xG6g7O10tRUN8knq4BoTc-ImPEpcm-qGTX2VouCgqtWklLXrKEXhI7e9cg-0k)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF16-PDUCdO13BE1vcnb-y_RZcqBxTtyDRydhr1fn3kHypUXXgO8nR_BBVqByulrjBHSze9hHYIklU_1xtWT2Qd2rx2X_czCV3TqUmNi6GNWBNqRocwRH0YlKIlqzaE70lqLY3suX_jpl6k4-mrx2OjwKB1JAnk12-7rWHTEBbA4LclxZjzfc08h2w57prtTbaKc15O4Q)
- **Total alcohol and pace:** According to the [National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism (NIAAA)](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF17KZkt23ONnBmwk5NYXeX-3BIuIERabo7b_Ry2t4zDShP8cRgv_1v1dnt1-UoYTQeaBafZ5QQeq30QSlLQIVhpaXJ7Fk13zsH9DuqKxXnVzEL2vyoKZEuUjDM78YI-xtyC9pUpxogpaoLtS0Avub9xP9bXzhFt15ktisy3JbA5q4) , hangover severity is driven primarily by how much alcohol you drink and how quickly—dehydration, poor sleep, stomach irritation, and acetaldehyde buildup all play major roles.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF17KZkt23ONnBmwk5NYXeX-3BIuIERabo7b_Ry2t4zDShP8cRgv_1v1dnt1-UoYTQeaBafZ5QQeq30QSlLQIVhpaXJ7Fk13zsH9DuqKxXnVzEL2vyoKZEuUjDM78YI-xtyC9pUpxogpaoLtS0Avub9xP9bXzhFt15ktisy3JbA5q4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1_prTz6waN-SJoRflSh2q2LM2l8XGSqT-8Yny6If8a1XRhP-0RibUABpTp_jaKIkPaX7ja3G3CIITSzvLs51Rhoal6t4sLVrBJ_FdaePB6Yl7sAdc-HUvvDnklfpExtZtAYNXNHA4nw2GY7ZDoSoWViGDQq21qBWNvsve5aspUJCzAB4gRw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXcqMMQcmgOZoBq-92-_s8shBvE10MG7SWeiRUeaqBpiyMUn4kz-mNkZ1Pe9xcxMJ0j2c60gEcwCZiaQ1jTFs5mOxsXMmEXThgAtnG3k78OyUIyA6DegkNb8MMboyfEb9o)
- **User discussions:** Most commenters on [Quora](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXX2ITJWdCeyf3QEjA71DNS0h1189wbOtN7YSPKnEJBJgjHqVWfh9SOUmzgzS7XtaAXcCROiH3AXSFPEXelUkvrDjl-fKmrj_0ZHdr7jGlGmyJ4cfvQe9iFPDAu_jfSOPY_Kklzt-vRvV8Zh2csEdc) agree that high congener levels in cognacs like Hennessy tend to aggravate hangovers compared to clear spirits.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXX2ITJWdCeyf3QEjA71DNS0h1189wbOtN7YSPKnEJBJgjHqVWfh9SOUmzgzS7XtaAXcCROiH3AXSFPEXelUkvrDjl-fKmrj_0ZHdr7jGlGmyJ4cfvQe9iFPDAu_jfSOPY_Kklzt-vRvV8Zh2csEdc)

### Reducing the Risk

- **Pace yourself and limit amounts:** Sip slowly and keep track of total pours, as cognac typically has around 40% ABV.
- **Hydrate and eat:** Drink water alongside your cognac and eat beforehand to slow alcohol absorption.
- **Give it time:** Per the [NIAAA](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF17KZkt23ONnBmwk5NYXeX-3BIuIERabo7b_Ry2t4zDShP8cRgv_1v1dnt1-UoYTQeaBafZ5QQeq30QSlLQIVhpaXJ7Fk13zsH9DuqKxXnVzEL2vyoKZEuUjDM78YI-xtyC9pUpxogpaoLtS0Avub9xP9bXzhFt15ktisy3JbA5q4) , no quick fix cures a hangover—only time, rest, and rehydration help as your body recovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX72judMKQlXN2ZfJvZib6664YCA-0kLbPPRTZewiomn7qCzmuD09YXBcAcPzc700IaTSLwNlPLIci8v_mOyPcIpGFboGXHGhwbaF1t5GaCJLCCEt_yTM1z3KnqZnxUw5VFVSonmYNpg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXcqMMQcmgOZoBq-92-_s8shBvE10MG7SWeiRUeaqBpiyMUn4kz-mNkZ1Pe9xcxMJ0j2c60gEcwCZiaQ1jTFs5mOxsXMmEXThgAtnG3k78OyUIyA6DegkNb8MMboyfEb9o)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF17KZkt23ONnBmwk5NYXeX-3BIuIERabo7b_Ry2t4zDShP8cRgv_1v1dnt1-UoYTQeaBafZ5QQeq30QSlLQIVhpaXJ7Fk13zsH9DuqKxXnVzEL2vyoKZEuUjDM78YI-xtyC9pUpxogpaoLtS0Avub9xP9bXzhFt15ktisy3JbA5q4)
